combat.formula.capacitorEndurance: Endurance = charge {charge} / (use {usePerSecond} per second - recharge {rechargePerSecond} per second)
combat.formula.hitChance: Hit chance = 0.5 ^ (tracking strain {trackingStrain} squared + range strain {rangeStrain} squared), with the target at {rangeKm} km against an optimal of {optimalRangeKm} km and a falloff of {falloffKm} km
combat.formula.lockTime: Lock time = clamp(0.75 s, 20 s, {coefficient} x sqrt({referenceScanResolution} / {scanResolution}) x sqrt({referenceSignatureMetres} / {signatureRadiusMetres}))
combat.formula.repairRate: Repair rate = {amountHitPoints} hit points / {cycleSeconds} s cycle

formula.insurance.payout: payout = hull reference value × payout fraction of the cover held (basic or enhanced), in whole credits
formula.insurance.payoutRecoveryGrant: payout = 0, because a recovery-grant hull has no insurance value
formula.market.stationBuyPrice: station buy price = mid price × (1 − effective spread), rounded to whole credits
formula.market.stationSellPrice: station sell price = mid price × (1 + effective spread), rounded to whole credits
formula.repair.totalPrice: ceil(hull reference value × (armour fraction × missing armour + hull fraction × missing hull) × station modifier × standing multiplier)
